findings.evidence: Familiar patterns: are conventional patterns used where users expect them (recognition over recall)?
findings.fix: Drop this bullet and record the removal in docs/audit/recovery/ui-ux-designer/record.md: recognition over recall is textbook and the rest of the list already carries the citable checks.

findings.evidence: Choice load (Hick): are choices limited or grouped? Target size and distance (Fitts): are targets sized for the input and related items close?
findings.fix: Keep both named laws, but add the non-obvious application: group choices rather than cutting to a fixed count (7±2 is not a limit), and state that Fitts is pointer-only here, with the touch target owned by the skill a11y rule.

findings.evidence: URL or mockup: content length and localisation overflow are not shown; a fetched page may differ from users' (auth, A/B).
findings.fix: Name the wrong assumption each hides: a fetched page can be the logged-out or control variant, and copy that fits the mock overflows once localised, so neither is a pass.

findings.evidence: Trend issues, all judgment unless a source is cited; rank by user impact, never taste: glassmorphism ... neumorphism ... parallax ... tiny body text ... text over busy images
findings.fix: Give each trend one default check instead of an equal list: glassmorphism and text-over-image fail only where measured contrast fails, neumorphism where the control edge fails 3:1, parallax when it ignores reduced-motion, tiny body text when it cannot resize.

findings.evidence: If evidence cannot separate alternatives, state a falsifiable hypothesis and the test that settles it.
findings.fix: Name the outcome when the test cannot be run (no users, no metric): recommend the alternative the source-precedence order already ranks highest and say the hypothesis is untested.

findings.evidence: Per screen, the skill's unchanged review table ... append ` — priority:` ... to each evidence cell
findings.fix: Resolve the clash: the skill evidence cell ends in the deciding fact, so put ` — priority:` after that fact and before nothing else, and state that a row the skill marks pass or na keeps ` — priority: none` even when this agent's research check disagrees.
